When a doctor’s office calls a health plan to confirm a patient’s coverage, the answer takes seconds. The hold can take much longer.

 Angle Health now answers those calls 24/7 with voice agents built on ElevenAgents. During the pilot:
- More than 90% of the calls the agents handled were resolved without a transfer.
- The provider team got back nearly 9,000 minutes a day for complex cases.

“What really impressed me was the 10% it was able to triage, understand why it couldn’t handle it, and move it to the right team,” said Abraham Duplaa , head of product at Angle Health.
